1.name: TEXT_CMNDEFQSTMAIN01_00848_KRILE_000_001
1.description: Who should we speak to first, do you think?
1.translation_description: Con chi dovremmo parlare per primo, secondo te?

2.name: TEXT_CMNDEFQSTMAIN01_00848_ERENVILLE_000_005
2.description: Wuk Lamat may not be as experienced or accomplished as her brothers, but she has an affinity for the people. For her, finding those willing to cooperate is as simple as asking.
2.translation_description: Wuk Lamat non è esperta o affermata quanto i suoi fratelli, ma sa entrare in sintonia con la gente. Per lei basta chiedere per trovare persone disposte a collaborare.

3.name: TEXT_CMNDEFQSTMAIN01_00848_ALPHINAUD_000_010
3.description: Even up close, the Hanu are remarkably similar to the Vanu. Aside from those brilliant feathers, of course.
3.translation_description: Anche da vicino, gli Hanu somigliano molto ai Vanu, a parte quelle splendide piume, naturalmente.

4.name: TEXT_CMNDEFQSTMAIN01_00848_ALISAIE_000_015
4.description: Is there a reason the Pelupelu all wear those masks...?
4.translation_description: C’è una ragione per cui tutti i Pelupelu indossano quelle maschere...?

5.name: TEXT_CMNDEFQSTMAIN01_00848_HANUHANUCOLLABORATOR4864_000_020
5.description: So...I can order anything I like at Xbalyav Ty'e? <hex:021A020203>Anything<hex:021A020103>!? The Third Promise is too generous!
5.translation_description: Quindi... da Xbalyav Ty'e posso ordinare tutto ciò che voglio? <hex:021A020203>Qualunque cosa<hex:021A020103>!? La Terza Promessa è fin troppo generosa!

7.name: TEXT_CMNDEFQSTMAIN01_00848_PELUPELUCOLLABORATOR4864_000_025
7.description: Unlimited tacos in exchange for a few days of my time? I'd be a fool to pass up that deal!
7.translation_description: Tacos illimitati in cambio di qualche giorno del mio tempo? Solo uno sciocco rifiuterebbe un’offerta del genere!

9.name: TEXT_CMNDEFQSTMAIN01_00848_WUKLAMAT_100_030
9.description: Come on, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─let's see what's waiting for us in the next village!
9.translation_description: Forza, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─vediamo cosa ci aspetta nel prossimo villaggio!

10.name: TEXT_CMNDEFQSTMAIN01_00848_KRILE_000_030
10.description: The rules of the contest seem clear enough now: the scenes from the saga point us in the direction of the electors, and the electors award us keystones for performing their feats. Simple!
10.translation_description: Ormai le regole della gara sono chiare: le scene della saga ci guidano verso gli elettori, che ci assegneranno pietrachiavi se supereremo le prove che ci propongono. Semplice!

11.name: TEXT_CMNDEFQSTMAIN01_00848_ERENVILLE_000_035
11.description: Wuk Lamat would have struggled to complete these feats alone. Bringing you together was the correct choice, it seems.
11.translation_description: Wuk Lamat avrebbe faticato a compiere queste imprese da sola. A quanto pare, è stata una buona scelta riunirvi.

12.name: TEXT_CMNDEFQSTMAIN01_00848_ALPHINAUD_000_040
12.description: With one keystone already in hand, we've made an auspicious start to the contest. Hopefully our next attempt is equally successful.
12.translation_description: Con una pietrachiave già in mano, abbiamo iniziato la gara sotto i migliori auspici. Speriamo di avere altrettanta fortuna al prossimo tentativo.

13.name: TEXT_CMNDEFQSTMAIN01_00848_ALISAIE_000_045
13.description: Without knowing how far the other claimants have progressed, taking anything other than a brief rest is out of the question.
13.translation_description: Senza sapere quanto siano andati avanti gli altri pretendenti, non possiamo permetterci altro che una breve pausa.

14.name: TEXT_CMNDEFQSTMAIN01_00848_PELUPELUCOLLABORATOR4864_000_050
14.description: Ooh, my belly... Long has it been since I've feasted so well.
14.translation_description: Oh, la mia pancia... Era da tanto che non mangiavo così bene.

15.name: TEXT_CMNDEFQSTMAIN01_00848_HANUHANUCOLLABORATOR4864_000_050
15.description: Xbalyav Ty'e is truly a wonder of the culinarian world.
15.translation_description: Xbalyav Ty'e è davvero una meraviglia del mondo culinario.
